description: Scope is deliberately limited to CI: action pins in .github/workflows and .github/actions, plus the tool versions those actions install (annotated with '# renovate:' comments, which the github-actions manager reads natively as depType 'uses-with').

Only Chart.yaml appVersion is tracked under charts/**. Containment comes from enabledManagers plus each custom manager's fileMatch, not from ignorePaths -- enabling helmv3 or helm-values would expose values.yaml and Chart.lock as well.

An appVersion PR deliberately fails ct's version-increment gate until a reviewer picks the Chart.yaml version bump: app patch -> chart patch, app minor -> chart minor. That call is left to a human because a new app minor often needs chart changes too, such as new values to expose, and the reviewer has to read the release notes either way.

appVersion tags are 'X.Y.Z-latest' -- a mutable tag republished when the image is rebuilt, so the version is pinned while rebuilds float. The regex versioning captures 'latest' as compatibility, which confines comparisons to that tag family and excludes plain X.Y.Z along with the .devN, aN and rcN variants. allowedVersions caps at 10.0.0 to exclude the 90.90.90 sentinel tag that exists in the rasa-pro repo, while still letting a real major be proposed as its own PR.

Label is 'dependencies', NOT 'automated'. The lint, lint-helm4 and kube-linter jobs all skip on a PR carrying 'automated', so these PRs used to merge with every check skipped -- including the kube-linter and Kyverno version bumps that Renovate itself raises, whose only validation is the job that was being skipped. 'automated' is reserved for the helm-index PR in chart-release-github-pages.yml, which edits charts/index.yaml and genuinely needs the chart gates bypassed.

packageRules.description: Group non-major action updates into a single PR
Majors get their own PR and must be approved on the dependency dashboard first, so input-schema and runtime changes are reviewed deliberately

azure/setup-helm controls which Helm binary CI runs. The OCI release action passes a full https:// URL to 'helm registry login', which only works on Helm 3, so this must never be bumped without checking the pinned 'version:' inputs.

Helm 3 pins must stay on Helm 3. The OCI release action runs 'helm registry login https://...', and Helm 4 accepts a bare domain only - moving these to 4.x breaks chart publishing until REGISTRY_URL drops the scheme. Matched on packageName because Renovate normalises depName to 'helm'. The lint-helm4 job's v4 pin is excluded by matchCurrentValue.
Tool versions passed as action inputs (helm, git-cliff, python) are plain version strings, not action refs. Digest pinning is meaningless for them and produces bogus 'pin dependencies' PRs.
Group non-major tool version bumps from the custom manager
Major tool version bumps are reviewed deliberately
Rasa Pro appVersion. Listed after the custom.regex rules above so it overrides their grouping and 'ci' scope: each chart needs its own PR, because each needs its own Chart.yaml version bump.
Studio appVersion. Note the chart major and the app major are decoupled: studio chart 3.x tracks the Studio 2.x app, so the cap here is a rail against junk tags and not a pin to the 2.x line.

customManagers.description: Tool versions passed as action inputs to actions Renovate does not know natively (orhun/git-cliff-action). The github-actions manager extracts 'uses-with' versions only for known actions such as azure/setup-helm, actions/setup-python and helm/chart-releaser-action - it does not read '# renovate:' comments.

Rasa Pro appVersion in charts/rasa/Chart.yaml. No '# renovate:' annotation, so that adding this needs no charts/** edit -- which would arm check-rc and ct's version-increment gate on a CI-only PR. The image name lives here instead.
Studio appVersion in charts/studio/Chart.yaml. Inert until a stable 'X.Y.Z-latest' tag is published; the repo holds only .devN tags at the time of writing.
